{{Quote|Prepare a course for the Poderis system, Captain; I want the Chimaera there within forty hours.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
The '''Poderis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Orus sector/Legends|Orus sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Poderis]].

==History==
During the [[Thrawn campaign]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] used Poderis as a red herring to throw [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] off in his search for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] traffic. The [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] tried to [[Mission to Poderis|intercept]] Skywalker's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in the Poderis system but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to escape using a [[Covert Shroud Maneuver]].
